content: The weight INLINEFORM0 was set empirically through several tests on the cQA-2016 development set ( INLINEFORM1 ). Table TABREF30 presents the results on the cQA-2016 and cQA-2017 test datasets. The hybrid method (LR+IR) provided the best results on both datasets. On the 2016 test data, the LR+IR method outperformed the best system in all measures, with 80.57% Accuracy and 77.47% MAP (official system ranking measure in SemEval-cQA). On the cQA-2017 test data, the LR+IR method obtained 44.66% MAP and outperformed the cQA-2017 best system in Accuracy with 67.27%.
